topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can’t believe you’re really leaving, you know? It’s like, we just got here, we just figured out all these amazing places to hang out, and you’re telling me it’s time to say goodbye? It’s crazy, all the plans we made, all the things we promised to do together. I’m going to miss you so much, and it’s not just the fun stuff, it’s the little moments too. Walking home late at night, those random text threads at 3 AM. I never thought I’d have to adjust to losing my constant, but here we are. I mean, I’m proud of you, moving forward, chasing your dreams. It’s just going to be really, really hard without you around.
